title.narrative: Engagement Facility (EF) – Rapid and flexible technical assistance to support engagement with Sarawak

description.narrative: The EF- Sarawak is established as a rapid and flexible response mechanism to support the Government of Sarawak on upstream policy results, test innovation with scale-up potentials, policy impact and evaluation, and support results identified in the CPD and in the 13th Malaysia Plan.Specifically, EF-Sarawak will be used to support the implementation of activities in Sarawak in support of the implementation of, but not limited to, the Sarawak Post Covid Development Strategy 2030 (PCDS) and the Sarawak’s 13th Malaysia Plan (S-13MP)Strategic Framework. The focus of the efforts is to support inclusive economic growth, mainstream climate and nature positive development approach and strengthengovernance institutions through various tools, instruments and mechanisms including but not limited to digitalization, strategic innovation, capacity building, policy and financing development.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
